nodes.label: Books Icon (Stack of Three Purple Books)
nodes.description: Stylized icon depicting a stack of three purple/magenta books with white pages, used as a UI element to represent books, library, scriptures, or reading material in the E-Tipitaka application. Likely represents access to the Tipitaka volumes/scripture collection.

nodes.label: Library / Scripture Collection Concept
nodes.rationale: A stacked-books visual is a conventional UI metaphor for 'library' or 'collection of texts'. In the context of E-Tipitaka (a Buddhist scripture reader), this icon most plausibly signifies access to the Tipitaka book collection or volume browser.
